brands.name: 42 Birds
brands.description: 42 Birds creates premium yoga mats with a focus on sustainability and performance. The brand uses innovative eco-friendly materials while maintaining luxury-level quality and design. Their commitment to both environmental responsibility and high-end performance has created a niche in the premium eco-conscious market.
brands.sustainability: Uses cutting-edge sustainable materials and eco-friendly manufacturing processes throughout their supply chain.
brands.bestKnownFor: Combining luxury quality with environmental responsibility
brands.targetAudience: Eco-conscious practitioners willing to invest in premium quality, luxury-seeking yogis

brands.name: Ajna Wellbeing
brands.description: Ajna Wellbeing specializes in holistic health products, including organic and eco-friendly yoga mats made from natural fibers like jute and recycled suede. The brand emphasizes sustainability, non-toxicity, and support for mind-body balance, with products designed to be durable, odor-resistant, and hygienic.
brands.sustainability: Prioritizes organic, recycled, and non-toxic materials; eco-friendly and sustainable production.
brands.bestKnownFor: Natural jute and eco suede yoga mats with antibacterial properties and odor resistance
brands.targetAudience: Eco-conscious practitioners seeking non-toxic, sustainable alternatives for yoga and wellness

brands.name: Alo Yoga
brands.description: Alo Yoga has emerged as a lifestyle brand that seamlessly blends yoga culture with contemporary fashion. Founded in 2007, Alo (Air, Land, Ocean) creates yoga mats that embody their California-cool aesthetic while delivering serious performance. Their mats are designed for both studio and outdoor use, featuring eco-friendly materials and innovative grip technology. The brand has gained a massive following among yogis and influencers alike, making their mats as much a fashion statement as a functional tool.
brands.sustainability: Alo Yoga uses sustainable materials including natural rubber and recycled materials. They're committed to reducing environmental impact throughout their supply chain.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Warrior Mat and their Instagram-worthy aesthetic that appeals to the wellness lifestyle community
brands.targetAudience: Lifestyle-focused yogis, social media savvy practitioners, and those who want mats that look as good as they perform

brands.name: Ananday
brands.description: Ananday focuses on creating yoga mats from mindfully sourced materials with minimal environmental impact. The brand emphasizes transparency in their supply chain and ethical manufacturing practices. Their approach appeals to practitioners who want to align their yoga practice with conscious consumption.
brands.sustainability: Prioritizes sustainable materials, ethical labor practices, and transparent supply chains.
brands.bestKnownFor: Commitment to ethical manufacturing and supply chain transparency
brands.targetAudience: Ethically-minded consumers, those who value supply chain transparency, conscious practitioners

brands.name: B Yoga
brands.description: B Yoga (known for the iconic B MAT) creates durable, grippy yoga mats designed for intense practices like hot yoga and Pilates. The brand emphasizes superior performance, comfort, and eco-conscious materials such as sustainably sourced rubber with Oeko-Tex certification. Their mats are favored for stability, longevity, and support in studio or home settings.
brands.sustainability: Uses sustainably sourced rubber and Oeko-Tex certified materials; focuses on long-lasting products to reduce waste.
brands.bestKnownFor: The B MAT series with exceptional grip and performance, even in sweaty conditions
brands.targetAudience: Serious yogis, hot yoga practitioners, and those seeking reliable, high-performance mats

brands.name: Bala
brands.description: Bala made waves in the fitness world with their aesthetically pleasing weighted bangles and has since expanded into yoga mats. The brand brings their signature approach—combining function with beautiful design—to create mats that are as visually appealing as they are practical. Bala targets a younger, design-conscious demographic that values products that seamlessly blend into their lifestyle.
brands.sustainability: Working toward sustainable materials and ethical manufacturing practices.
brands.bestKnownFor: Award-winning product design and their distinctive aesthetic that appeals to millennials and Gen Z
brands.targetAudience: Design-conscious yogis, younger practitioners, those seeking Instagram-worthy gear

brands.name: Gaiam
brands.description: Gaiam has been making yoga accessible since 1988, offering quality yoga mats at affordable prices. As one of the most recognizable names in yoga accessories, Gaiam provides an entry point for beginners while still offering premium options for experienced practitioners. Their wide product range spans from basic PVC mats under $20 to premium natural rubber options, making them available at major retailers nationwide. While they may not have the cache of premium brands, Gaiam's reliability and value have made them a staple in yoga studios and home practices alike.
brands.sustainability: Gaiam offers eco-friendly options in their premium lines using natural rubber and recycled materials, though their budget lines still use PVC.
brands.bestKnownFor: Accessible pricing, wide retail availability, and the Premium Yoga Mat series
brands.targetAudience: Beginners, budget-conscious practitioners, and those seeking widely available options

brands.name: Gayo
brands.description: Focuses on sustainable, non-toxic mats (cork + natural rubber, organic cotton). Offers alignment lines, bolsters, kits. Emphasizes mind-body-spirit connection.
brands.sustainability: Sustainably sourced cork/rubber, organic materials, chemical-free.
brands.bestKnownFor: Eco-friendly cork yoga mat with superior grip and alignment features.
brands.targetAudience: Eco-conscious practitioners, those seeking non-slip cork for hot yoga, mindful wellness seekers.

brands.name: Heathyoga
brands.description: Heathyoga has carved out a unique position in the yoga mat market by offering high-quality, feature-rich mats at accessible price points. This brand focuses on bringing professional-grade features to budget-conscious yogis without compromising on performance. Their mats often incorporate alignment lines, extra thickness for joint protection, and eco-friendly materials—features typically reserved for premium brands. Heathyoga has gained a loyal following among beginners and experienced practitioners alike who appreciate getting exceptional value for their investment.
brands.sustainability: Uses TPE (thermoplastic elastomer) materials which are recyclable and free from harmful chemicals like PVC, latex, and phthalates.
brands.bestKnownFor: Professional-quality features at budget-friendly prices with alignment marking systems
brands.targetAudience: Budget-conscious yogis, beginners seeking guidance features, home practitioners, those with joint sensitivities

brands.name: House of Mats
brands.tagline: Premium yoga mats designed to elevate your practice
brands.description: Where excellence meets sustainability. We offer premium yoga mats designed to elevate your practice, reflect your style, and care for the planet. Join our wellness community today
brands.sustainability: Uses sustainable materials; focuses on environmental awareness.
brands.bestKnownFor: Mats that blend style, performance, and eco-friendliness.
brands.targetAudience: Style-conscious yogis, wellness communities.

brands.name: Hugger Mugger
brands.description: As one of the pioneering yoga product companies in America, Hugger Mugger has been outfitting yoga studios and practitioners since 1986. Based in Salt Lake City, the company started by making yoga bolsters and blocks before expanding into mats. Their deep roots in the yoga community and decades of experience show in their well-designed, functional products that prioritize performance over flash. Hugger Mugger remains a trusted name among yoga teachers and studio owners.
brands.sustainability: Offers eco-friendly options using natural rubber and earth-friendly materials, though they still produce some PVC mats for budget-conscious customers.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Para Rubber Mat and their trusted reputation among yoga studios and teachers
brands.targetAudience: Yoga teachers, studio owners, and practitioners who value proven reliability over trends

brands.name: IUGA
brands.description: IUGA offers budget-friendly yet feature-packed yoga mats with excellent non-slip surfaces, eco-friendly materials like TPE and PU, and options for alignment lines and extra thickness. The brand combines comfort, durability, and value, making professional-grade features accessible for everyday practitioners, including hot yoga and Pilates.
brands.sustainability: Uses eco-friendly, non-toxic TPE and PU materials that are free from harmful chemicals; recyclable options emphasized.
brands.bestKnownFor: Grippy, durable mats with superior traction at accessible prices, popular for hot yoga and home workouts
brands.targetAudience: Budget-conscious yogis, beginners to intermediate practitioners, home workout enthusiasts

brands.name: JadeYoga
brands.description: JadeYoga pioneered the natural rubber yoga mat when they launched in 2000, creating an eco-friendly alternative to PVC mats. Every Jade mat is made from sustainably harvested rubber tapped from rubber trees, providing excellent grip and cushioning without synthetic materials. The brand goes beyond materials—for every mat sold, Jade plants a tree in partnership with Trees for the Future. Their commitment to giving back and environmental stewardship has made them a favorite among eco-conscious yogis who don't want to compromise on performance.
brands.sustainability: Jade is deeply committed to sustainability: 100% natural rubber mats, tree planting program (1 million+ trees planted), no PVC or synthetic materials, and US manufacturing reduces carbon footprint.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Harmony Mat (5mm) and their one-tree-planted-per-mat environmental program
brands.targetAudience: Eco-conscious practitioners, those who value grip and cushioning, and yogis who want to support environmental causes

brands.name: Jollie
brands.description: Jollie creates cushioned, non-slip yoga mats with a strong social mission: for every mat purchased, they donate one to a child with pediatric cancer. The brand focuses on supportive, comfortable designs that make movement accessible and fun, often featuring playful patterns and collaborations (e.g., with Tuckernuck). Their mats prioritize extra cushioning and grip for various practices.
brands.sustainability: Focuses on durable, high-quality materials; mission-driven rather than heavily eco-focused.
brands.bestKnownFor: Buy-one-give-one model supporting pediatric cancer patients and comfortable, supportive mats
brands.targetAudience: Compassionate practitioners, families, beginners, and those who value purpose-driven brands

brands.name: KEEP
brands.tagline: Foldable, portable mats for on-the-go yoga.
brands.description: KEEP offers portable yoga mats designed for convenience and performance.
brands.sustainability: Uses recyclable materials in some lines; focuses on sustainable portability.
brands.bestKnownFor: Portable yoga mats with 61cm width for travel.
brands.targetAudience: Travelers, home practitioners, budget-conscious yogis.

brands.name: Liforme
brands.description: Liforme burst onto the scene in 2013 with a bold claim: to create the world's best yoga mat. The UK-based company has backed up this ambition with innovative features including their signature AlignForMe system—subtle alignment markers that help practitioners perfect their form without being distracting. Their mats feature a unique GripForMe surface that gets grippier when wet, making them ideal for hot yoga. Liforme's commitment to eco-friendly materials and ethical manufacturing has earned them a dedicated following among environmentally conscious yogis.
brands.sustainability: Liforme mats are made from biodegradable, non-toxic materials that are free from PVC and harmful chemicals. They're manufactured using renewable energy sources.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Original Yoga Mat with patented AlignForMe system and planet-friendly materials
brands.targetAudience: Alignment-focused practitioners, hot yoga enthusiasts, eco-conscious yogis willing to invest in premium quality

brands.name: Lululemon
brands.description: Lululemon, the athletic apparel giant founded in 1998, has successfully translated their expertise in technical fabrics into high-performance yoga mats. Known initially for their yoga pants, Lululemon entered the mat market with the same attention to detail and innovation. Their mats feature antimicrobial additives, natural rubber bases, and grippy polyurethane top layers designed to handle even the sweatiest practices. The brand emphasizes both function and aesthetics, offering mats in stylish colors and patterns that complement their apparel line.
brands.sustainability: Lululemon has committed to using sustainable materials and has introduced recycling programs. Their newer mats incorporate natural rubber and they're working toward net-zero emissions.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Mat 5mm series — reversible design with excellent sweat management and antimicrobial features.
brands.targetAudience: Fashion-forward yogis, Lululemon loyalists, hot yoga practitioners, and those who value brand aesthetic

brands.name: Manduka
brands.description: Manduka is a premium yoga mat manufacturer known for their lifetime-guaranteed PRO series. Founded in 1997 by Peter Sterios, a dedicated yogi and entrepreneur, Manduka has built a reputation for creating some of the most durable and high-quality yoga mats on the market. The brand's philosophy centers on sustainability and longevity—they believe in creating products that last a lifetime rather than contributing to landfill waste. Their signature closed-cell surface prevents sweat and bacteria from seeping into the mat, making them a favorite among hot yoga practitioners.
specialty: Strong focus on longevity to reduce waste
eKO line uses natural tree rubber.
brands.sustainability: Manduka is committed to sustainable manufacturing with emissions-free production facilities, zero-waste programs, and partnerships with environmental organizations. Their EKO series uses natural tree rubber.
brands.bestKnownFor: The PRO series mat with lifetime guarantee — often called the "last mat you'll ever buy."
brands.targetAudience: Serious practitioners willing to invest in premium quality, hot yoga enthusiasts, and eco-conscious yogis

brands.name: MoonHoli
brands.tagline: Premium yoga mats made with love, and a touch of magic
brands.description: MoonHoli creates premium yoga and fitness mats, clothing, and accessories designed in resonance with the Universe. Their products feature sacred geometry, cosmic vibes, spiritual symbolism, and beautiful artistic prints. Mats are made from eco-friendly materials like natural rubber, microfiber, or eco-polyurethane, with non-slip technology and non-toxic, water-based paints. The brand blends high-quality craftsmanship, environmental care, and a touch of magic to enhance yoga, pilates, meditation, and fitness practices for body, mind, and soul.
specialty: Spiritually inspired designs with sacred geometry and cosmic themes
brands.sustainability: Strong focus on eco-friendliness: uses natural rubber (no PVC or toxic materials), water-based paints derived from fruits and vegetables, ethical production processes that prioritize environmental safety and non-toxicity for both users and the planet.
brands.bestKnownFor: Beautiful, spiritually designed premium yoga mats considered among the most aesthetically pleasing and high-quality on the market, popular among yogis seeking both performance and cosmic/magical energy in their practice.
brands.targetAudience: Yoga practitioners (beginners to advanced), pilates and fitness enthusiasts, spiritually-minded individuals, eco-conscious consumers, and those who value aesthetic beauty combined with functionality in wellness products.

brands.name: Öko Living
brands.description: Öko Living specializes in certified organic and eco-friendly yoga mats. The brand takes environmental responsibility to the next level with third-party certifications and rigorous standards for materials and manufacturing. Their mats are designed for practitioners who refuse to compromise between environmental values and performance.
brands.sustainability: All products are certified organic and eco-friendly with third-party verification. Uses only pure, chemical-free materials.
brands.bestKnownFor: Certified organic materials and uncompromising environmental standards
brands.targetAudience: Environmentally strict practitioners, those with chemical sensitivities, organic lifestyle advocates

brands.name: prAna
brands.description: prAna is a leading sustainable active lifestyle brand offering yoga mats alongside apparel for yoga, climbing, and outdoor activities. Their mats emphasize eco-friendly materials like recycled content and natural elasticity, with excellent grip, cushioning, and durability for versatile practices. The brand integrates sustainability across their entire line.
brands.sustainability: Uses recycled materials, organic content, and eco-conscious manufacturing; committed to reducing environmental impact.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Verde Yoga Mat series with thick cushioning, rebound, and sustainable design
brands.targetAudience: Eco-aware yogis, outdoor enthusiasts, and practitioners seeking durable, ethical gear

brands.name: prAna Verde
brands.description: The prAna Verde is a standout yoga mat line known for its thick, firm cushioning (around 4mm), excellent rebound, anti-slip grip, and eco-friendly construction using sustainable and recycled materials. It balances comfort for joints with performance for various yoga styles, earning high marks in independent reviews for durability and sustainability.
brands.sustainability: Eco-friendly materials with recycled components; part of prAna's broader sustainability commitment.
brands.bestKnownFor: Dense, springy feel with strong grip — praised in reviews as a top sustainable mid-range option
brands.targetAudience: Practitioners wanting extra cushion without sacrificing grip or eco-values

brands.name: Primasole
brands.description: Primasole specializes in functional, affordable yoga mats including foldable travel options, thick cushioning models (up to 10mm+), and non-slip designs for yoga, Pilates, and floor exercises. Known for lightweight portability, carry straps, and color variety, they offer practical solutions for home, gym, or on-the-go use.
brands.sustainability: Focuses on durable, functional materials; limited emphasis on eco-certifications compared to dedicated sustainable brands.
brands.bestKnownFor: Foldable yoga mats ideal for travel and thick, cushioned options for joint support
brands.targetAudience: Travelers, beginners, home users seeking affordable and portable mats

brands.name: Scoria
brands.description: Scoria is a newer player in the cork yoga mat space, focusing on premium performance and innovative design. The brand combines sustainable Portuguese cork with advanced grip technology to create mats that excel in hot yoga and high-intensity practices. Scoria emphasizes their commitment to ethical manufacturing and transparency in their supply chain, appealing to conscious consumers who want to know exactly where their products come from.
brands.sustainability: Uses sustainably harvested cork and emphasizes ethical manufacturing practices with transparent supply chains. Cork from Portugal, rubber from Vietnam; 100% biodegradable and renewable.
brands.bestKnownFor: High-performance cork mats designed specifically for hot yoga and intense practices
brands.targetAudience: Hot yoga enthusiasts, eco-conscious practitioners, and those seeking premium cork alternatives

brands.name: Sensu
brands.description: Sensu is passionate about sports, wellness, and relaxation and we are committed to creating products that represent our values and reflect our dedication in offering nothing but the best for our customers.
brands.sustainability: Focuses on durable, high-density materials; some eco options in premium lines.
brands.bestKnownFor: Extra-large mats for full movement in yoga, pilates, and grounding.
brands.targetAudience: Men and women seeking spacious, stable mats for home/gym use.

brands.name: Shakti Warrior
brands.description: Shakti Warrior is a sustainable and eco-friendly yoga mats and Accessories Brand. Our range includes eco-friendly Yoga Mats, handmade Bags and comfortable clothing.
brands.headquarters: New York, NY, USA (founded in India)
brands.sustainability: Uses TPE and recycled plastic; non-toxic and sustainable.
brands.bestKnownFor: Artist-designed, premium eco mats for regular/hot yoga.
brands.targetAudience: Eco-conscious yogis, those seeking meaningful, stylish gear.

brands.name: Stakt
brands.description: Stakt is a female-founded wellness brand that reimagines the yoga mat with foldable designs for versatility and support.
brands.sustainability: Uses sustainable materials like FSC-certified rubber; committed to functional, eco-conscious products.
brands.bestKnownFor: The Stakt Mat, a 2-in-1 foldable mat that doubles as a block.
brands.targetAudience: Versatile fitness enthusiasts, travelers, and home workout users.

brands.name: Sumo Yoga
brands.tagline: Wabi-sabi (侘寂) - find beauty in imperfection, impermanence, and simplicity
brands.description: Sumo Yoga is a mindful movement brand and practice that fuses the grounding strength and mobility of traditional sumo wrestling (including shiko squats for hip opening and emotional release) with the fluid flow of yoga. Rooted in Japanese heritage and the wabi-sabi philosophy, it promotes self-acceptance, body positivity, and freedom from judgment, celebrating 'perfect imperfections' and every unique body.
specialty: Sumo-Inspired Hip-Opening and Emotional Release Practices
Shiko squat (for core strength, hip flexibility, and emotional release)
Tatami yoga mats and handmade accessories
brands.sustainability: Committed to conscious commerce through the Sumo Cares Project; products are sustainably sourced and meticulously handmade in Japan to support local communities, preserve traditions, and address Japan's population challenges while emphasizing natural, durable materials.
brands.bestKnownFor: Unique fusion of sumo wrestling strength with yoga flow for physical power, emotional liberation, and self-love; high-quality tatami yoga mats; promoting authenticity and body acceptance through the wabi-sabi lens.
brands.targetAudience: Individuals seeking a strength-based, mindful yoga practice focused on hip-opening for emotional release, self-acceptance, body positivity, and Japanese-inspired wellness—regardless of body type or experience level.

brands.name: Satori Concept
brands.description: The company's philosophy is inspired by the Zen Buddhist concept of "Satori," which means awakening to one's true nature. Their mission is to inspire moments of mindfulness and connection to the world, reflected in the use of sustainable, natural cork and rubber materials for their yoga products. Besides cork mats, they also offer vegan suede yoga mats (made from absorbent microfiber) and various yoga accessories.
specialty: Sustainable, high-performance yoga products, particularly natural cork and rubber yoga mats.
brands.sustainability: Their primary products are made from sustainably sourced, 100% natural cork and natural rubber, which are biodegradable and non-toxic.
brands.bestKnownFor: Eco-friendly yoga mats made from natural cork and tree rubber.
brands.targetAudience: Individuals who are interested in wellness, mindfulness, yoga, and sustainable living

brands.name: Wolo
brands.tagline: Vegan leather and rubber mats for high-grip, eco-conscious practice.
brands.description: Wolo yoga mats and accessories are made with sustainable materials like natural rubber and cork. Designed for yogis, crafted for high performance, and truested by yoga teachers. FREE shipping and returns.
brands.sustainability: Uses natural rubber, cork, and vegan leather; committed to eco-friendly practices.
brands.bestKnownFor: Mastery Mat for non-slip, teacher-recommended performance.
brands.targetAudience: Yogis in Malaysia/Singapore; those seeking affordable, sustainable gear.

brands.name: Yoga Design Lab
brands.description: Yoga Design Lab blends fashion-forward design with innovative function and eco-conscious materials (e.g., water-based inks, recycled bottles). Active and thriving in 2026 — new designs released (e.g., Zenith in early 2026). Founded 2014 in Bali (inspired by founder Chad Turner). Uses recycled materials, biodegradable natural tree rubber, water-based inks. Sold in 55+ countries.
brands.sustainability: Recycled and eco-materials, no harmful substances.
brands.bestKnownFor: Stunning, nature-inspired prints on eco-mats (e.g., Celestial Combo Mat XL).
brands.targetAudience: Fashion-forward, eco-conscious yogis who want style + performance.

brands.name: Yoga Kargha
brands.tagline: Premium Earth Friendly Yoga Products Made in India
brands.description: YogaKargha (a sub-brand of AbhinehKrafts) creates handmade, eco-conscious yoga mats, meditation cushions, blankets, props, and accessories using natural and organic materials. Products are designed to make yoga, meditation, and wellness accessible to everyone, blending ancient Indian traditions with modern functionality. They focus on earth-friendly essentials like organic cotton handwoven mats, grass-fiber options, and supportive items for various practices.
specialty: Handwoven, natural-fiber yoga mats (organic cotton, darbha grass, vetiver grass, banana fiber) with anti-skid options, machine-washable features, and traditional techniques like hand-block printing
also meditation props (zafu/zabuton cushions, wooden benches, Iyengar chairs), blankets, and sustainable furniture
emphasis on multi-functional, artisanal designs for yoga, Pilates, meditation, and home decor.
brands.sustainability: Highly committed: uses GOTS-certified organic cotton, natural/biodegradable fibers (vegan, plastic-free), eco-friendly/natural dyes (e.g., indigo), upcycled/recycled materials, no harsh chemicals; sustainable packaging, zero textile waste (scraps repurposed), fair wages for artisans (especially women), audited suppliers, partnerships like with Goonj for community yoga programs; fully biodegradable products that connect users to nature.
brands.bestKnownFor: Premium, handcrafted organic cotton and grass-fiber yoga mats (e.g., Amrit design, undyed natural versions, anti-skid block-printed indigo mats) praised for grip, cushioning, durability, and joint support; excellent reviews for eco-friendliness, quality, and authenticity; top sellers include handwoven organic mats and meditation sets; stands out as one of the leading creators of truly sustainable, plastic-free yoga gear from India.
brands.targetAudience: Yoga and meditation practitioners of all levels (beginners to advanced), including those into Hatha, Vinyasa, Iyengar, restorative, hot yoga, or prenatal; eco-conscious individuals seeking natural, biodegradable alternatives to synthetic mats; people valuing artisanal craftsmanship, sustainability, and Indian heritage; suitable for home practice, travel (foldable/lightweight options), families, and anyone wanting accessible, earth-friendly wellness tools regardless of age, background, or location.

brands.name: YogaMatters
brands.tagline: Comprehensive yoga supplier with sustainable, high-quality mats.
brands.description: Yoga mats and bags, equipment and accessories, yoga clothing, books, gifts and more - everything you need for your yoga journey with free UK delivery over £75.
brands.sustainability: Offers sustainable mats from cork, rubber, and organic materials.
brands.bestKnownFor: Trusted for full yoga essentials with eco-friendly bestsellers.
brands.targetAudience: Yoga studios, teachers, and global practitioners.

brands.name: Yogi Bare
brands.description: Yogi Bare is a UK-based brand that combines natural materials with modern performance features. Their mats feature natural rubber bases with unique grip surfaces designed for hot yoga and intense practices. The brand emphasizes their commitment to environmental responsibility while maintaining premium quality standards. Yogi Bare has gained popularity in Europe and is expanding into North American markets.
brands.sustainability: Uses natural rubber from sustainable sources and emphasizes eco-friendly manufacturing processes.
brands.bestKnownFor: Their Paws mat with unique texture and excellent hot yoga performance
brands.targetAudience: Hot yoga practitioners, eco-conscious European market, those seeking unique grip textures

brands.name: Yoloha
brands.description: Yoloha specializes exclusively in cork yoga mats, bringing a unique material to the yoga mat market. Founded by two yoga-teaching brothers in California, Yoloha discovered that cork's natural antimicrobial properties and incredible grip (especially when wet) made it ideal for yoga. Cork is also sustainably harvested from the bark of cork oak trees without harming the tree, making it one of the most eco-friendly mat materials available. The natural aesthetic and feel of cork has created a loyal following among yogis looking for something different from traditional rubber or PVC mats.
brands.sustainability: Cork is harvested from renewable cork oak bark without harming trees, making it one of the most sustainable mat materials. Yoloha partners with reforestation efforts.
brands.bestKnownFor: Their Original Cork Yoga Mat with natural antimicrobial properties and distinctive look
brands.targetAudience: Hot yoga practitioners, eco-conscious yogis, those with latex allergies, and practitioners seeking unique materials

brands.name: YuneYoga
brands.tagline: Awaken the individuality and creativity within
brands.description: Yune Yoga creates high-quality, non-slip yoga mats, towels, straps, blocks, and accessories that are beautifully designed with unique, lively prints and patterns. The brand transforms the traditionally bland yoga product space into a colorful, artistic canvas, emphasizing premium quality, comfort, and expression in your practice. Products are crafted with eco-friendly materials (such as PER, natural rubber, or recycled components), free from phthalates, latex, and toxins.
specialty: Design-oriented yoga products, including vibrant, custom-inspired graphics on mats and accessories
collaborations (e.g., with Pendleton for patterned designs)
and performance features like superior grip for hot yoga or vinyasa flows.
brands.sustainability: Strongly committed to eco-friendliness: mats use sustainable PER or natural rubber materials (free of harmful chemicals), printed with eco-friendly inks; towels from recycled microfiber; plastic-free packaging; small-batch production to reduce waste; 1% of purchases donated to environmental non-profits; emphasis on recyclable and non-toxic products.
brands.bestKnownFor: Unique, eye-catching artistic designs and prints on yoga mats (e.g., animal patterns like leopard/tiger, nature-inspired motifs, or collaborations); high customer ratings for quality, grip, durability, and customer service; portable/foldable travel mats; and turning yoga gear into a lively, personalized expression of individuality.
brands.targetAudience: Yoga practitioners of all levels (beginners to advanced) who value style, creativity, and sustainability; eco-conscious yogis; those seeking vibrant, non-boring gear for home, studio, hot yoga, travel, or outdoor practice; fitness enthusiasts wanting expressive, high-performance accessories.
